body:
Adds `research/slip-twin`: a kinematic-bicycle twin of a car ignores tyre slip. Steady-turn radius is off by exactly 1+Kv²/L; calibrating K fixes that, but both twins certify steering gains stable at every speed while 11 of 30 real gain pairs lose stability below 60 m/s. Includes tests (10), experiments, white paper, README bullet and site entry; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
